verdict.rationale: Paxos documents concrete off-ramp rails: redeem (stablecoin→USD) and withdraw to bank via Fedwire, SWIFT, and CUBIX networks, with fiat account creation/deletion and deposit instructions APIs. However, all documented examples are USD-denominated settlement to a bank account; there is no published list of supported non-USD currencies or countries for recipients, so the 'across a published set of currencies and countries' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: multi-currency conversion support, an explicit published country/currency coverage list, evidence of non-USD local payout rails.
